03 / SIGNAL PATH4 STAGES / 1 RECORDSTEREO

From voice note to final master.

No mystery chain. Four clear stages, one conversation at a time.

  1. 01 / LISTEN

    Bring the rough idea.

    A demo, a lyric sheet, a reference playlist or just the melody—you don’t need to arrive “ready.”

  2. 02 / BUILD

    Find the song’s language.

    Tempo, key, structure, drums and textures. We make choices that support the voice, not bury it.

  3. 03 / CAPTURE

    Get the take.

    A focused session with room to try things. We keep the technical side out of the artist’s way.

  4. 04 / FINISH

    Make it travel.

    Mix, revisions and a final master that holds together on headphones, phones, cars and club systems.
